name: The Marcus Portrush
stayType: Boutique hotel in a restored Victorian building
accommodation: Boutique bedrooms including designated pet-friendly rooms; family rooms on request
parking: On-street parking only (paid and unpaid), per tourism listing
dogs: Dogs up to 15kg in selected rooms and the bar; non-refundable pet fee
beachAccess: About 0.24 miles (around 400m) from East Strand, per tourism listing
confirmedFeatures: Nemesis Asian Fusion restaurant, Heritage cocktail bar, lounge, lift, air conditioning, gym, Wi-Fi, accessible bedroom with roll-in shower, cots and highchairs
overview: The Marcus is a boutique hotel in a restored 1880s building in Portrush, around 400 metres from East Strand. It has an Asian fusion restaurant, a cocktail bar and a gym, and offers pet-friendly rooms for smaller dogs. Family rooms and an accessible bedroom can be requested.
surfTripFit: A five-minute walk to East Strand makes early checks easy, and the dog-friendly rooms suit travellers bringing a dog.
